For Thursday's #UrbanGaze, this is a photo of Lower Belen, a district of Iquitos, Peru. A floating shantytown and with the Amazon River, and its tributaries near flood stage, many houses were almost under water. Sometimes referred to as the 'Venice of the Amazon'. Poverty is everywhere.

A few years ago I took a 3-day cargo boat ride down the Amazon to Iquitos and slept in Mick Jagger's bed. I stayed at Casa Fitzcarraldo, where Jagger, Klaus Kinski, Claudia Cardinale and Werner Herzog were based during the filming of Fitzcarraldo (1982). Cool place.
